name: Michael Bloomberg

current_role: Founder of Bloomberg L.P.; philanthropist and Democratic megadonor
summary: Michael Bloomberg founded the financial data and media company Bloomberg L.P., was mayor of New York City from 2002 to 2013, and ran for the 2020 Democratic nomination. A leading Democratic donor, he gave about $80 million in the 2026 midterms, is Josh Shapiro's biggest backer, and spent millions against Zohran Mamdani in 2025.
